lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Mountain Village Town Council taking up first reading of an ordinance that would move Housing Authority fees out of the municipal code into an annually updated fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set that every workforce-housing resident should understand. Alongside that, San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group meets for its eighth session to keep chipping away at Land Use Code provisions that slow affordable housing production, and HARC sits down for a work session on a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall — the Town-owned building where HARC itself meets.
